description: Development contracts read only through this consumer’s explicit rule-V7 opt-in lane. The family has published FHT 1.0 (shared v0.7.0) and native FHGM 0.1 (shared v0.8.0); this registry does not adopt their released selection URLs or add them to this build’s released registry. Each contract and suite is independently pinned by its source file’s last-touch commit and SHA-256. No raw-main fetch occurs during validation. The lane remains default-off and warns on every opted-in record. The runner verifies local vendored-contract integrity and suite pins before scoring; CI separately checks owning contract checkouts at the recorded contract commits; results stay separate from the immutable shared v0.6.0 291-vector acceptance ledger.
rule: docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md rule V7 (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#221/#226, text published at tag v0.6.0)

transportOverlay.note: Unreleased draft transport overlay, pinned at its own last-touch commit 019bc29e32ce225791053dd2ce323bb91f304ce1 under the unified convention (bytes unchanged from 019bc29e through head b1a82f82f8a2d4a5f5e78240edaa05c6bd9222d8, re-verified 2026-11-18): v0.5.0 carrier citation pairs with schemaVersion 1.1; v0.6.0 citation pairs with 1.1 or 1.2, consistent with those released bytes - the 1.1 pairing and the FHR-Specification v0.6.0 alias are additions of this overlay relative to the 2026-11-15 d1619cce bytes. Exact eight registered carrier URLs are drawn from its closed schema enums; main and unknown releases are rejected in the draft lane. The full pairing check remains opt-in via overlay=true. This changes no released schema, contract identity or V7 default. Historical prior overlay and digest remain recorded in parent cfbab3d8; this dated refresh makes no contract adoption claim.

FHGM.note: Historical x-fhgm-models transport remains opt-in, separate from the published native FHGM representation. K1/K2/K3/K5/K6 are implemented. K4 requires caller-supplied decoded gene row IDs; the development-suite runner does not parse the feature layer and reports every K4-dependent case not-run, including expected-valid cases. A partial model pass never establishes a resolved gene target.

familyPublication.note: Family publication is separate from this consumer development-lane refresh; released selection/adoption is not implemented by these pins.
